supported_findings.evidence: Full regression coef 2.03, p~5e-252; holdout R2 ~0.77 with X1,X2,X3 core.
Interaction test coef 0.749, p~1.5e-18, delta R2 0.074; holdout test R2 rises from 0.765-0.772 to 0.873-0.878 when X4:X5 added, replicating out of sample. X4 and X5 are nearly uncorrelated (r=0.037).

interaction_claims.reason: Highly significant product term (p=1.5e-18) with large holdout gain (test R2 ~0.77 to ~0.88); X4 and X5 main effects are small, so the effect is mainly via the interaction.
p=0.069, delta R2 0.003; marginal and not robust.

causal_claims.reason: Observational regression; no randomization or design to identify causal effects.
Effect appears only through interaction with X5; no causal inference supported.
Effect appears only through interaction with X4; no causal inference supported.
